text: ほかの　ポケモンと　たたかわせて　もっと　もっと　つよくするぜ！

structure.jp: ほかの　ポケモンと　たたかわせて
structure.en: I'll make it fight other Pokémon and

structure.jp: もっと　もっと　つよくするぜ！

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: Changing the verb ending to せる means making or letting someone do it. たたかわせて = 'make it fight, and'.

patterns.name: 〜くする
patterns.explanation: A describing word with its い changed to く, plus する, means to make something that way. つよくする = 'make it strong'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is a rough, boyish way to push what you say. つよくするぜ = 'I'm gonna make it strong!'
